author: Top Gear
description:
This is the new Porsche 911 GT3 S/C, and might it be the worst 911 GT3 ever? Sure, all the usual GT3 ingredients are there, from a 503hp flat-six that screams to 9000rpm, to a manual gearbox that drives the rear wheels. But something’s also missing, and that’s the roof – because the S/C is really a 911 GT3 Cabriolet by another name. Has Porsche forgotten the motorsport-inspired ethos of its GT department and ruined the 911 GT3? 

🚗 Porsche 911 GT3 S/C
🎤 Jethro Bovingdon
